svg.title: AWS EC2 LAMP environment architecture
svg.desc: A browser resolves mahiroaws.website with Route 53, then connects through an internet gateway and Elastic IP to an EC2 instance in a public subnet. A security group permits HTTP, HTTPS, and restricted SSH. AlmaLinux, Apache, PHP, and MySQL run on the EC2 instance.
svg.text: 独自ドメイン・HTTPS対応の学習／検証環境
通信・設定のポイント
mahiroaws.website を Route 53 で名前解決
MySQLはEC2内部で利用（外部公開なし）
